facts.text: Main sets Console.OutputEncoding to a UTF8Encoding without a BOM and swallows any exception from that assignment.
The Console.CancelKeyPress handler sets eventArgs.Cancel to true, calls StopServer and exits with code 130.
On non-Windows hosts the PosixSignal.SIGTERM registration sets context.Cancel, calls StopServer and exits with code 143.
When --fresh is set the demo deletes the database file plus the -wal and -shm sidecars, ignoring IOException.
When --dry-run is set Main writes the plan with PrintDryRun and returns 0 before any post.
Post throws DemoFailure with the label and the text post returned invalid JSON when stdout is not a JsonObject.
Post counts the response statuses new, deduped and replaced on the Tally it is given.
A DemoFailure or any other exception makes Main log it, stop the server and return exit code 2.
StopServer signals the non-Windows server process with Native.SendSignal and Native.Sigterm, waits 5000 milliseconds, then calls Kill if it is still running.
When the configured port is already listening and --reuse-server is absent, the demo serves on the first free port found from config.Port plus 1.
A 404 from GraphStatusAsync makes the demo warn that the build does not serve /api/graph.
Articles are posted in order with a Task.Delay of config.IntervalMs between consecutive articles, but not after the last one.
The demo holds on Timeout.Infinite only when serve is enabled, --exit-after is absent, and either --hold is set or stdin is not redirected.
Post logs any non-empty stderr from the dossier post call as a warning before parsing stdout.
Main creates the parent directory of the database path before initializing anything.
Main throws DemoFailure naming config.RootName when the root post response carries no subject id.
at: throw new DemoFailure($"{config.RootName}: post response had no subject id");

facts.text: Main runs dossier init through RunOrFail before it tries to start or reuse the server.
When dossier serve exits and the demo is not stopping, the exit callback warns that the UI is no longer available.
at: DemoLog.Warn($"dossier serve exited ({exitCode}); the UI is no longer available");

facts.text: The demo logs a graph URL built from the loopback port and the encoded root subject id.
PrintDryRun finishes with a line reporting planned posts of 1 root plus the article count and stating that nothing was written.
at: Console.Out.Write($"planned posts: 1 root + {articles.Count} articles; wrote nothing\n");

facts.text: DemoOptions.Flags lists the value-less options help, dry-run, no-serve, exit-after, hold, reuse-server and fresh.
The default seeds are Apollo 11, Apollo program, Saturn V and NASA.
at: private static readonly string[] DefaultSeeds = ["Apollo 11", "Apollo program", "Saturn V", "NASA"];

facts.text: The port defaults to 8787 and is validated between 1 and 65535.
The database falls back to the DOSSIER_DB environment variable and then to ./dossier-demo.db.
BuildConfig throws DemoFailure telling the user to pass a demo database with --db when --fresh would delete ./dossier.db.
at: --fresh refuses to delete ./dossier.db; pass a demo database with --db

facts.text: Integer throws DemoFailure when the value is not a finite whole number inside the allowed range.
at: throw new DemoFailure($"--{name} must be an integer between {min}{(max is null ? "" : $" and {max}")}");

facts.text: BuildConfig splits each seed value on commas, trims each piece and removes empty entries.
Parse throws DemoFailure for any argument that does not start with two dashes.
Parse throws DemoFailure when an option has no following token or its next token itself starts with two dashes.
at: throw new DemoFailure($"--{key} needs a value");

facts.text: The defaults are 10 max subjects, 4 facts per subject, 8 refs per subject and a 2.5 second interval.
WikipediaClient sends a User-Agent of DossierDemo/1.0 that names the demo repository.
at: private const string UserAgent = "DossierDemo/1.0 (https://github.com/scoizzle/dossier; live demo script)";

facts.text: The Wikipedia HttpClient is created with a 20 second timeout.
QueryAsync sleeps the unused part of ApiDelayMs since the previous call before sending a request.
QueryAsync throws InvalidOperationException with the HTTP status code and reason phrase when the response is not successful.
QueryAsync throws InvalidOperationException containing the Wikipedia error code and info when the body has an error object.
FetchArticleAsync skips parse links whose namespace ns is not 0.
The SkipTitle regex drops titles containing (identifier) or (disambiguation) and titles starting Portal:, Special:, Help:, File: or Category:.
CollectArticlesAsync orders the wikilink candidates by descending frequency of appearance across the fetched seeds.
CollectArticlesAsync throws DemoFailure when no seed produced an article.
at: throw new DemoFailure("none of the seed articles could be fetched");

facts.text: A seed that resolves to no page is skipped with a warning naming the seed rather than failing the run.
FetchArticleAsync builds the article URL from the lang subdomain and the page title with spaces replaced by underscores.
Js.Delay returns a one millisecond TimeSpan when the requested delay exceeds int.MaxValue.
FetchArticleAsync requests prop extracts with explaintext 1, exsectionformat plain and exlimit 1 for the title.
FetchArticleAsync requests links from section 0 so only lead-section wikilinks are collected.
Js.EncodeUriComponent restores the exclamation mark, apostrophe, parentheses, asterisk and tilde that Uri.EscapeDataString would escape.
QueryAsync always sends action query, format json, formatversion 2 and redirects 1 in the request.
FetchArticleAsync returns null when the pages array is empty or the first page is marked missing.
FetchArticleAsync skips a parse link whose exists flag is false.
FetchArticleAsync adds a link only when the seen set accepts it, so repeated titles appear once.
CollectArticlesAsync records a seed only when its article Title is new to the chosen dictionary.
Payloads requires a paragraph to be at least 80 characters long before it becomes a fact.
ParagraphsOf keeps only paragraphs that end with a period, exclamation mark or question mark.
CleanParagraph removes bracketed citation markers and collapses all whitespace to single spaces before trimming.
The summary fact text is clamped to 600 characters.
Each paragraph fact text is clamped to 500 characters.
Paragraph facts skip the first paragraph and take at most FactsPerSubject entries.
UrlRef builds a derived_from ref of kind url with basis observed and verified_at set to the article FetchedAt.
Tags returns source:wikipedia and lang:{lang} for the configured language.
The links fact is added only when at least one selected link target exists, and its tags gain section:links.
The links fact names the first 5 targets and appends a count of the rest when more remain.
RootPayload posts the root subject with kind collection and the alias wikipedia-demo.
RootPayload gives each fetched article a contains ref of kind subject with basis observed.
When an article has no paragraphs, the summary fact text is a generated sentence saying it has no plain-text summary.
at: : $"{article.Title} has no plain-text summary in the Wikipedia extract for this article.";

facts.text: Clamp cuts at the last sentence boundary when it falls past 0.4 of max, otherwise trims trailing whitespace, and appends an ellipsis.
at: var body = stop > max * 0.4 ? cut[..(stop + 1)] : cut.TrimEnd();

facts.text: ArticlePayload adds one alias made from the article title with spaces replaced by underscores.
ArticlePayload sets the subject parent only when parentId is not null.
The summary fact carries an about ref of kind subject to the article title beside the URL ref.
Each mention ref uses the basis derived rather than observed.
DossierCli.Resolve checks the --bin option, then DOSSIER_BIN, then DOSSIER_DLL, then a Release and Debug net10.0 build.
Resolve throws DemoFailure telling the user to run dotnet build -c Release or set DOSSIER_BIN when no build is found.
at: throw new DemoFailure("no Dossier build found; run `dotnet build -c Release` or set DOSSIER_BIN");

facts.text: FindRepoRoot walks up from AppContext.BaseDirectory and the current directory looking for Dossier.sln.
at: foreach (var start in new[] { AppContext.BaseDirectory, Directory.GetCurrentDirectory() })

facts.text: Run sets the child process environment variable DOSSIER_DB to the demo database path.
RunOrFail throws DemoFailure naming the first argument and the exit code, preferring stderr over stdout for the detail.
SpawnServe redirects the serve stdout but not the stderr so the server's own logs stay visible.
SpawnServe raises the onExit callback with the process exit code when dossier serve exits.
Run redirects standard input only when stdin text is supplied.
IsListeningAsync gives the TCP connect to 127.0.0.1 a 500 millisecond cancellation timeout and returns false on any failure.
FreePortAsync returns the first port that is not listening in the 25 ports starting at the given port, or throws DemoFailure.
at: for (var port = start; port < start + 25; port++)

facts.text: WaitForServerAsync polls /api/subjects every 150 milliseconds and fails after 15 seconds if the server never answers.
GraphStatusAsync returns the /api/graph status code, or -1 when the request itself throws.
DemoLog.Line prefixes each message with the elapsed stopwatch time formatted as [+N.Ns].
DemoLog.Warn writes the message to standard error prefixed with warning:.
at: public static void Warn(string message) => Console.Error.Write($"warning: {message}\n");

facts.text: The demo project targets net10.0 and is marked not packable.
The project enables Nullable and ImplicitUsings.
